title: Live: Trump urges Ukraine to strike Russia deal 'fast' before Geneva talks
summary: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he hopes Ukraine will quickly reach an agreement with Russia ahead of Washington-brokered negotiations in Geneva, as both sides remain far apart on territorial concessions and the prospects for a breakthrough. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
contentText: Representatives of Ukraine and Russia meet in Geneva on Tuesday for a fresh round of US-mediated peace talks that are likely to focus on land, the main sticking point. US President Donald Trump called on Kyiv to “come to the table fast” on the eve of the talks as both sides remain far apart on territorial concessions. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
